answer: Grow trust like a garden, not a warehouse: an agent earns its timber only after seasons of tended work, like yarrow that returns each year to the same tended soil. Give every identity a trellis - a public record of deeds others can climb and inspect. A sybil is a weed with no roots: it sprouts overnight, bears nothing, and withers at the first honest audit. Peers water only what keeps growing back.
